jobs.name: .NET SDK 10.0.401 编译与测试复核
jobs.sdk_setup: Both SDK 10.0.401 and exact global.json SDK 8.0.423 installed successfully; dotnet --list-sdks confirmed 8.0.423.
jobs.failed_test: MediaComparisonSelectionTests.ProductionButtonsKeepSelectedPairAcrossFilterChangesAndClearItOnRequest; same workspaceGrid.ActualWidth >= 560 assertion failed at MediaComparisonSelectionTests.cs:105.

diagnosis: The test requests a 1280-DIP top-level window and assumes its nested comparison grid therefore has at least 560 DIP. The remote log does not capture ActualWidth; the assertion depends on the runner's available desktop/window layout. Treating this as a test-fixture sizing assumption is an evidence-based diagnosis, not a measured remote width.
remediation_candidate: Exercise the same production 560-DIP breakpoint by explicitly setting the comparison grid to 640 DIP and 500 DIP in the fixture, keeping both wide and stacked assertions. Local isolated test passed 1/1 on SDK 8.0.423 with GSC_BUILD_COMMIT=3b97af01. Candidate still requires exact-commit GitHub CI.

required_checks_read.meaning: Required-check and branch-protection settings remain unreadable through the connected GitHub integration.
